ui.title: Due Diligence Questionnaire Risk Analyzer
ui.tagline: Reads a counterparty's completed due diligence questionnaire, checks the answers against your risk policy while screening for adverse information, scores the risk with cited drivers, and routes it - accept, analyst review with a two-day timeout, or the risk committee.

actions.label: Run: Due diligence questionnaire review
actions.description: A completed due diligence questionnaire arrives. Kaman extracts the answers, checks them against your risk policy and screens the counterparty for adverse information in parallel, scores the risk, and routes it: low risk is accepted, medium goes to an analyst, high is escalated to the risk committee.

inputs.name: questionnaire
inputs.label: Questionnaire
inputs.default: Q1 Ownership: 62% held by Northwind Holdings (Cayman)... Q7 Sanctions policy: Annual review, last updated 2023... Q12 Litigation: None disclosed... Q15 Data protection: ISO 27001 certified, certificate expired June 2026...

actions.label: Ask the Risk Policy Analyst
actions.description: Checks questionnaire answers against the risk policy.

inputs.name: question
inputs.label: Your question
inputs.default: Check Northwind Capital Partners' answers against the uploaded risk policy.
